outliers.headline: The 'Live Offline' Payoff
outliers.recommended_angle: Frame a personal, aspirational 'live offline' moment not as a vacation, but as the direct, intentional result of building the right online systems. Show how one half of the equation (building online) explicitly funds the other (living offline).
my_hooks: Closing a new client from a sailboat in the middle of the Pacific.
Three weeks completely offline in the mountains because the business ran itself.
My ‘office’ was a sea kayak for the entire month of August.
Taking midday freedives right after finishing morning client calls.
How I ran a workshop for fifty people from a cabin with no cell service.
my_talking_points: I posted a story of me closing a new client from a sailboat in the middle of the Pacific, and my inbox was full of questions.
People see that and they think it is luck, or that I am just on a permanent vacation. The truth is, it is neither.
That moment was not an accident. It was the result of a business that was intentionally designed to run without my constant attention.
This is the whole idea behind 'Build Online, Live Offline'. You build the online engine once, so you can spend your time back in the field.
For example, my entire client intake process is automated. A potential client can find my work, get the information they need, and book a discovery call without me manually sending a single email.
That one system alone saves me five to ten hours every single week. That is time I get to spend on a boat, with my family, or just being present.
That is how you end up on a sailboat, able to actually enjoy the moment, while your business continues to grow in the background.
If you have an expertise but want to build an online business that actually buys back your time, this is what we do.
Comment the word FIELDWORK below, and I will send you the details on how we build these systems.

production_guidance: A-Roll: Simple talking head of Christian, ideally in a natural setting like his office with a window view or outdoors.
